title: Zhalia Moon/Quotes
summary:
"In this world, you have to look out for yourself."
- Zhalia Moon ("Words of Truth, Heart of Lies")

"It must have been her regal blood. Great power comes from a noble family name. Even a name like yours."
- Zhalia Moon, to Sophie Casterwill ("Crawling the Catacombs")

"You mean besides being tackled by pint-sized Seekers like you? Dante asked me to come!"
- Zhalia Moon, to Lok Lambert after he asks her what she is doing here ("The Legacy of Thor")

"That's right, I was left to die, why should I help anyone... No, it's a trick!"
- Zhalia Moon snapping out of being manipulated by Madea ("The Beautiful Trap")

"Well, at least Dante trusts me."
- Zhalia Moon, to Sophie Casterwill ("Like Father, Unlike Son")

"Yeah well, I come here all the time. I kinda like their fries."
- Zhalia Moon after she helped Sophie Casterwill and Lok Lambert defeat Suits at the diner. ("All Work and No Pay")

"For the one who finally gave you a chance, you'd do anything."
- Zhalia Moon, to Dante Vale ("The Sceptre Deception")

"When this is all over, everybody will show me respect right?"
- Zhalia Moon to Klaus ("The Vampire Loses Its Fangs")

"Life is about power, and The Organization is about getting power. That's why we will always dominate!"
- Zhalia Moon to Sophie Casterwill ("The Vampire Loses Its Fangs")

"I was an orphan too, I lived here until someone like them offered me a way out, with a catch."
- Zhalia Moon to Den and Harrison Fears ("Den vs Harrison")

"If I ever want to make a difference, I have to do what I do best."
- Zhalia Moon to Dante Vale, getting ready to infiltrate The Blood Spiral. ("Zhalia's Mission")
